sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Build the grid for level 2
# Block centers: rows at y=22,25,28,31,34; cols at x=13,16,19,22,25,28,31,34,37,40,43,46,49
# Map: (row, col) -> color

grid_map = {}
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:  # Skip background
        continue
    if n['color'] == 'M':  # Skip bottom bar
        continue
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    
    # Map to block coords
    block_rows = [22, 25, 28, 31, 34]
    block_cols = [13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46, 49]
    
    br = None
    for i, y in enumerate(block_rows):
        if abs(center_r - y) < 2:
            br = i
            break
    bc = None
    for j, x in enumerate(block_cols):
        if abs(center_c - x) < 2:
            bc = j
            break
    
    if br is not None and bc is not None:
        grid_map[(br, bc)] = n['color']

print("Grid map:")
for r in range(5):
    row_str = ""
    for c in range(13):
        if (r, c) in grid_map:
            row_str += f" {grid_map[(r,c)]}"
        else:
            row_str += "  ."
    print(f"Row {r}:{row_str}")

# Agent at (4,0), target at (0,12)
# Test UP movement
result = action(['UP'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
blue_nodes = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
for n in blue_nodes:
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    print(f"\nAfter UP: agent center=({center_r:.1f}, {center_c:.1f})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
